title: Invalid resource file causes Godot to crash
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.8.dev.custom_build [00932449c]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (00932449c) - 'Gentoo' '2.18' on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (nvidia; 595.84) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.54 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Sometimes trying to load resource files causes Godot to crash while trying to load them.

```toml
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://bnx247jqbp4k0"]

[node type="Node"]
```

### Steps to reproduce

Save this tscn into any project:
```toml
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://bnx247jqbp4k0"]

[node type="Node"]
```
Open it with the editor.
